name: st-peters-basilica
description: Surveyed Latin-cross basilica, apses, four subsidiary domes, sixteen-rib principal dome and lantern; Maderno facade with portals, loggias, giant order, clocks and thirteen statues; Bernini mapped open colonnades, trapezoid arms, 140 parapet saints, piazza paving, obelisk and fountains.
attribution: Plans © OpenStreetMap contributors, via Protomaps, ODbL 1.0. Original architectural geometry and sculpture silhouettes for Vearth.

audit.dimension_uncertainty: Vatican RA explicitly gives 133.30m street-to-cross; model applies that above plaza datum without adding threshold rise. Rounded FAQ gives136m with no level basis. Roof tiers and individual sculpture poses are interpretations; 305 surveyed small support centres comprise shafts and piers, while primary total is 284 columns plus 88 piers. Source 61.38m center terrain is rejected as roof contamination. Threshold rise 3.3m and gentle plaza grade are estimates, not a conservation level survey.
audit.grounding: Open plaza sample at [300,8] is 24.5035m; threshold 3.3m higher. Lower-only convex cuts correct demonstrable DSM roof contamination beneath modeled basilica, graded arms and paved plaza, preserving streets beyond authored paving.
audit.orientation: All mapped positions and east-facing facade rotation are baked in metric east/up/north.

geometry: original metric geometry authored for Low Poly Earth from cited architectural references
